reason: Crexendo sells cloud-based business phone and unified communications (UCaaS) software on subscription to SMBs and white-label channel partners. TDS is mainly a facilities-based network operator. It sells fiber broadband, TV and phone to consumers and communities, and it owns wireless and tower assets. TDS Telecom does also offer businesses VoIP advanced communications solutions, so there is some overlap in voice and in small and mid-sized business customers. The core businesses differ: Crexendo is a software platform, while TDS is an asset-heavy carrier serving mostly residential and rural customers. That makes TDS adjacent, not a direct competitor.
